findings.title: Unsubscribe crashes when the user has no TopicUser row
findings.body: TopicUser.find_by can return nil, for example when the user is receiving notifications through a watched category or has never visited/interacted with the topic in a way that created a topic_users row. Lines 107-113 then call tu.notification_level and tu.save! unconditionally, raising NoMethodError and returning a 500 instead of unsubscribing. The action should create/update the row (e.g. via TopicUser.change, as set_notifications does) rather than assuming one exists.

findings.title: Per-topic unsubscribe mutates notification state on a GET request
findings.body: The new routes in config/routes.rb expose unsubscribe as GET and this action immediately changes and saves notification_level. Any logged-in browser request to the emailed URL therefore mutates state without confirmation or CSRF protection, so mail-scanner link prefetching, browser prefetch, or a cross-site /link to /t/:slug/:id/unsubscribe can silently mute/downgrade a topic the user never intended to unsubscribe from. A state change like this should require POST (or an explicit confirmation step) with CSRF protection.

findings.title: Unsubscribe bypasses TopicUser.change bookkeeping and live updates
findings.body: Unlike TopicsController#set_notifications, which uses TopicUser.change, this action assigns tu.notification_level and calls tu.save! directly. That bypasses the notifications_changed_at/notifications_reason_id (user_changed) bookkeeping and the MessageBus /topic/:id notification_level_change publish (and after-save observers) performed by TopicUser.change, so other open clients and topic-tracking state keep showing the old watching/tracking level until a full reload, and the change is not recorded as a user-initiated notification change.

findings.title: unsubscribe_link translation now hard-requires unsubscribe_url for every unsubscribe email
findings.body: config/locales/server.en.yml changes the shared unsubscribe_link string to include %{unsubscribe_url}, and both the HTML path here and body (line 90) render it via I18n.t('unsubscribe_link', template_args) whenever add_unsubscribe_link is true. template_args only contains unsubscribe_url when the caller passes it, and MessageBuilder treats it as optional (only UserNotifications#send_notification_email supplies it). Any other current/future/test caller that sets add_unsubscribe_link: true without a topic-specific URL will now raise I18n::MissingInterpolationArgument and fail to send; the new spec change that had to add unsubscribe_url to an existing generic builder illustrates the coupling. The per-topic line should be conditional or the translation should be given a safe default.

findings.title: No tests cover the new unsubscribe endpoint or that the topic URL reaches the email
findings.body: The only spec change adds unsubscribe_url to the fixture builder but adds no expectation that the unsubscribe_url appears in the body/HTML, and there are no controller specs for TopicsController#unsubscribe at all. The watching/tracking -> regular and regular/muted -> muted transitions, the missing-TopicUser case, the slug-redirect case, and unauthenticated/inaccessible-topic behavior are all untested, so the nil-row crash and level-transition regressions above would pass CI undetected.
